content:
name: Setup Runtime Dashboard
description: Setup Node and install runtime dashboard dependencies.

inputs:
  install-deps:
    description: Whether to run pnpm install.
    required: false
    default: "true"
  install-playwright:
    description: Whether to install Playwright Chromium and OS dependencies.
    required: false
    default: "false"
  node-version:
    description: Node version to provision.
    required: false
    default: "22"
  working-directory:
    description: Runtime dashboard working directory.
    required: false
    default: "policy-engine/apps/runtime-dashboard"

runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Enable corepack and activate the pinned pnpm
      # setup-node's cache: "pnpm" resolves the directory to cache by running
      # `pnpm store path`, so pnpm must be on PATH before that step: corepack
      # ships with the runner's Node but is not enabled.
      #
      # Enabling it is not enough on its own. The corepack shim resolves its
      # version from the nearest packageManager pin, and this repository keeps
      # that pin in policy-engine/package.json while setup-node runs from the
      # repository root, where there is none. The shim therefore fell back to
      # corepack's own default pnpm, a different major with a different store
      # layout: setup-node recorded /home/runner/.local/share/pnpm/store/v11
      # while `corepack pnpm install` populated the pinned 10.x's store/v10, so
      # the post-run save looked in a directory nothing had written to.
      #
      # Activating the pin here makes the root-level shim resolve to the same
      # pnpm the install uses, so both sides name one store. Naming the store
      # explicitly does not fix this on its own - pnpm appends the store-layout
      # version to whatever directory it is given, so two different majors stay
      # in two different directories.
      shell: bash
      working-directory: policy-engine
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        corepack enable
        corepack prepare --activate
        pnpm --version

    - name: Setup Node
      uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
      with:
        node-version: ${{ inputs.node-version }}
        cache: "pnpm"
        cache-dependency-path: policy-engine/pnpm-lock.yaml

    - name: Install workspace dependencies
      if: inputs.install-deps == 'true'
      shell: bash
      working-directory: policy-engine
      run: corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

    - name: Install Playwright browsers
      if: inputs.install-playwright == 'true'
      shell: bash
      working-directory: ${{ inputs.working-directory }}
      run: corepack pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
